text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(That night, what woke me was the feeling 
of a gentle breeze on my cheek.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Nn...... The window... is open...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Zephyr-san?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it was just a flurry of falling 
blossoms. I'm sorry for scattering your 
dream.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I was wide awake... so I gave in. Now 
then, let us have some calm.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Sleepless nights... happen to everyone, 
don't they?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"I'm alright. Let's throw it open—with all 
our might."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...! Ah... what a pleasant breeze...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
That's right... The usual—that one. Please 
wait just a moment.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much. Tonight, I shall 
surrender myself to the spring breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It feels like an early summer breeze... 
Bouquet-san's chamomile milk tea, that is.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Today... I brewed it a bit lighter. With 
just a single spoonful of honey, too...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
No wonder... It has such a gentle 
sweetness. Fufu... It feels like a warm 
breeze flowing through my stomach...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: âCan you see it?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Far in the distance. They sparkle 
even more when seen from the forest.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Th-That star over there, right? It's 
very... beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
When I look up from atop the great tree, 
the heavenly winds tell me just a little.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ah... The swift breeze again... Fufufu... 
It truly is a wonderful night.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Oh? Something came flying this way...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
My... a horned owl? How rare... Are you 
unable to sleep as well?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Mimi-san. Such a wandering wind, all the 
way out in a human settlement.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Oh, were you Zephyr-san's friend? 
Look—it's holding something in its mouth.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: For me...? A blessed wind, is it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: âLavender? Ah, could it be...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"What I was... growing in the greenhouse? 
This variety shouldn't grow wild in the 
mountains..."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
My, what a mischievous little one. You 
mustn't cause a violent storm, now.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It's all right. That just shows 
how much you were worried about 
Zephyr-san.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ………… Thank you very much, both of you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Umâcould I borrow this lavender for a 
moment?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"There are some flowers and herbs... that 
seem like they'd be a great match."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how lovely. The gentle scent of a 
peaceful meadow...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Here's a mini-bouquet to help you sleep 
peacefully. Put this by your pillow... I'm 
sure... it'll bring you sweet dreams.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Bouquet-san... Thank... you... 
*Yaaawn*... Good... ni..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Good night, Zephyr-san.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you as well. I'll go ahead and 
close the window—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Please get home safely. ...Good night.

—One morning before class started, I saw 
Curren Bouquetd'or and Yamanin Zephyr 
chatting amicably.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Ah―― Good morning, Trainer-san.
choice_data_list: Good morning! How are you two doing?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Last night, I waited for the wind to 
carry me toward my dream. The glittering 
stars, the birdsong, all so tender... The 
sentiment behind the golden bouquet was 
like a gentle, sunlit breeze.

"I didn't quite understand, but I could 
tell a gentle atmosphere surrounded them. 
Surely, the two of them..."
choice_data_list: You two get along well, huh?
Did you have a nice evening?

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Yes, very much so. Fufufu...

Perhaps something happened last night. 
Something known only to the two of them...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes— It was a calm, slightly magical 
night.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
When I'm with Zephyr-san— I feel like I 
can sense the breath of distant nature...
